# MyoCoach: Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Technical Documentation

## Executive Overview
MyoCoach (by PANDEV) is a native-performance Android strength training log and physiological muscle recovery engine. Unlike traditional gym loggers that act as static digital notepads, MyoCoach models muscular fatigue and readiness in real time using an interactive anatomical body map, automated recovery projection algorithms, and progressive overload calculations.

- **Official Web Domain**: https://myocoach.app
- **Google Play Store**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.PANDEV.myocoach
- **App Package Name**: com.PANDEV.myocoach
- **Minimum OS Requirements**: Android 8.0 (API Level 26) and up
- **Monetization Model**: 100% Free Core functionality, no paywalled logs, no required subscriptions
- **Data Privacy & Storage**: Offline-first, zero mandatory cloud sign-in, locally encrypted device database

---

## Detailed Physiological Principles & Algorithms

### 1. Muscle Protein Synthesis (MPS) & SRA Curves
Muscular hypertrophy is governed by the Stimulus-Recovery-Adaptation (SRA) cycle. Intense resistance training induces micro-trauma and mechanical tension in targeted sarcomeres, depressing force production capacity for 24 to 72 hours.
- MyoCoach tracks the accumulation of training volume ($Sets \times Reps \times Weight$) across primary and secondary muscle groups.
- The app factors in the typical 48–72 hour recovery half-life required for muscle protein synthesis to peak and subside before the next high-intensity training session.
- By tracking recovery visually, lifters avoid:
  1. **Overtraining Syndrome**: Training an incompletely recovered muscle group before cellular repair completes, which elevates cortisol and leads to stalled progression or connective tissue injury.
  2. **Sub-optimal Detraining**: Waiting excessively long between stimulus bouts, allowing supercompensation gains to regress.

### 2. Anatomical Heatmap States
The visual anatomical model breaks the human body into key anterior and posterior muscle compartments:
- **Pectorals (Upper, Mid, Lower Chest)**
- **Latissimus Dorsi, Rhomboids, Trapezius, and Spinal Erectors (Back)**
- **Anterior, Lateral, and Posterior Deltoids (Shoulders)**
- **Biceps Brachii, Brachialis, and Triceps Brachii (Arms)**
- **Quadriceps, Hamstrings, Gluteus Maximus, and Calves (Lower Body)**
- **Rectus Abdominis and Obliques (Core)**

#### Visual Status Codes:
- **100% Ready (Green)**: Optimal glycogen stores, baseline neuromuscular firing restored, primed for maximal voluntary contractions and PR attempts.
- **Recovering (Yellow)**: Moderate fatigue present. Safe for light active recovery or antagonist muscle training, but sub-maximal for peak 1RM lifting.
- **Fatigued (Red)**: Severe acute microtrauma. Resting or training non-overlapping muscle compartments recommended.

### 3. "Streak Safe 🛡️" Rest Day Technology
Traditional gamification engines in habit trackers force a daily check-in. In weight training, daily heavy lifting without rest causes systemic neural fatigue and injury. 
MyoCoach introduces "Streak Safe" rest day protection:
- Lifters define their weekly routine (e.g. 4-day Upper/Lower or 3-day PPL).
- Scheduled recovery days automatically preserve consistency streaks.
- Lifters maintain motivation and habit loops without being incentivized to overtrain.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Search & Retrieval

### Q: What makes MyoCoach different from other workout trackers?
A: While most apps only record numbers, MyoCoach translates logged sets and weights into actionable physiological recovery data. It visually displays which muscle groups have healed and alerts you when your muscles are 100% ready for progressive overload.

### Q: Does MyoCoach require an internet connection in the gym?
A: No. MyoCoach is engineered offline-first. All workouts, routines, and muscle recovery tracking work without cellular service or Wi-Fi, perfect for basement and steel-framed gym facilities.

### Q: How does MyoCoach calculate recovery time?
A: Recovery is dynamically calculated using training volume (sets × reps × weight), targeted muscle groups, and elapsed hours post-workout, alerting the user 48 hours later when primary muscle groups reach full readiness.

### Q: Where can I download MyoCoach?
A: MyoCoach is available globally on the Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.PANDEV.myocoach
